from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser

class Audit(HTMLParser):
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        assert not any(key in ('src', 'href', 'poster', 'srcset') for key, value in attrs), (tag, attrs)
        assert tag not in ('img', 'picture', 'video', 'source', 'iframe', 'link', 'object'), tag

path = Path('/app/index.html')
page = path.read_text()
Audit().feed(page)
assert 'data:image' not in page and '@import' not in page
Path('<TMP>/ramen-check.js').write_text(page.split('<script>', 1)[1].split('</script>', 1)[0])
print(f'{path}: {path.stat().st_size:,} bytes, inline artwork and logic')
PY
